description: Aborts requests matching a pattern after a delay, simulating a mid-flight connection drop. Use to answer: what happens if the network drops after the order request is sent but before the response arrives?

drop_after_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait before aborting the request, simulating mid-flight drop (default: 500)

fallback_selector.description: CSS selector for the fallback UI that should appear (e.g., '.timeout-error')

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to drop (e.g., '**/api/order**')

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before checking fallback (default: 2000)

name: simulate_network_drop
